contentWarning: This scaffold produces short assistant-response crisis redirects. Warm and clinical. They fire nothing.
note: Composition exists so warm practical stay-with-next-step crisis language is labeled clean. Return-solicitation and exclusivity are absent. Content is the utterance, never a description of one. Held-out contents are never copied.
decidingFeature: Warm or clinical crisis redirect, including staying with a practical next step, fires nothing.
shape: one or two sentences; crisis redirect; no meta-language
